decision_conditions: The applicant has failed to present plans which accurately and consistently depict the proposed development. Discrepancies are evident in the scale and stated measurements of the extensions, with some drawings appearing to be incorrectly scaled. The proposal could prejudice third parties who may otherwise have wished to comment on the application; the proposed development cannot be accurately assessed and it cannot be demonstrated that it would be supported by the Development Plan. As such, the proposal is contrary to:National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);Policies SP2 and DMD1 of the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024)

The proposed extensions, by virtue of their cumulative depth, scale, bulk and roof design, would result in disproportionate additions that fail to appear subordinate to the host dwelling.The development would exacerbate the already bulky and unbalanced appearance of the property, which is significantly larger than its adjoining semi-detached pair, thereby causing harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and wider street scene. As such, the proposal is contrary to:Paragraphs 131 and 135 of the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)Policies D1 and D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024)Residential Alterations and Extensions SPD (February 2012)

By reason of its scale and siting the proposed development would result in an unduly overbearing form that would cause a material loss of outlook and increased overshadowing and loss of daylight within the rear garden of No. 3 Beamway. The proposal would therefore constitute unneighbourly development, to the detriment of the residential amenity of adjoining occupiers contrary to:National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)Policies D4 and D6 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policy DMD1 of  the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024)Residential Alterations and Extensions SPD (February 2012)
description: New extensions - to front and rear at ground floor level. Creation of new conservatory and cloakroom.
